status: DESIGN_FROZEN with amendments A and B adopted (2026-09-23) and amendment D adopted (2026-09-25, inside the window, before any formal execution); execution gated on corpus freeze receipt; not started

window.rule: no task, metric, arm, prompt, grid, budget or parser change inside the window; a bug fix is recorded in the record and forces a full rerun of every arm

one_task.name: ledger v2 obligation closed loop with open administrator requests, including release-time estimates
one_task.episode: 12 native intervals; single request at tick 2; sequence at ticks 2 and 7; pair (release-time statement then backup latency request) at ticks 2 and 4; the conference actually ends at the release tick stated on the scenario card (default 10), backup 4 MB deadline tick 8, recovery within 2 intervals
one_task.input_corpus: data/open_requests/corpus.json frozen by docs/reproduce/open_requests_freeze_<date>.json; eligible in_schema_single, in_schema_sequence and in_schema_pair items enter the primary comparison; beyond_schema items are reported as coverage gaps
one_task.world_seed: sha256(item id) modulo 2^31; one seed per item; identical for all arms
one_task.runner_lineage: scripts/run_frozen_protocol.py; executor src/vera/frozen_protocol.py; ledger src/vera/obligation_ledger.py; planner src/vera/obligation_planner.py; admission assess_timed over src/vera/obligation_static_rule.py; language interfaces src/vera/revision_v2.py; SHA of each pinned at STARTED time
one_task.ledger: obligation_ledger v2: six QoS fields, backup.deadline total_bytes/deadline_tick, recovery.max_intervals, priority.order, release_estimate.earliest_tick; one field per message
one_task.admission: static_estimate: static feasibility rule whose recovery check holds the candidate configuration until the administrator-stated earliest release tick and requires the real escape certificate to fit the recovery window; without an estimate it is the plain static rule
one_task.planner: obligation_planner: same candidates and safety layer as the frozen planner; priority-weighted violations, deadline as required rate, recovery-window cap count

one_metric.name: administrator_obligation_satisfaction
one_metric.definition: fraction of native intervals in the episode in which every obligation valid at that interval according to the independent annotation (base ledger plus each annotated reference request from its message tick onward) is met by realised QoS; a request that an arm rejects, defers or misparses leaves its obligation unmet from its message tick; hard-SLA violations make the interval unmet
one_metric.paired: per corpus item, difference arm minus rule

arms.rule: src/vera/revision_v2.py rule_request: transparent same-information rule written before any corpus item existed; covers the six QoS fields, deadline tick/bytes, recovery window, priority order and release-time estimates (relative/absolute, approximate wording minus one tick); abstains otherwise
arms.qwen7b_two_stage_lenient: DECISIVE language arm (amendment A, 2026-09-23): frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, two-stage compilation - stage 1 picks the obligation type from the closed list of all ledger v2 obligation types plus none, stage 2 returns only the value; engine patches the ledger; stage-1 decoding accepts a bare closed-list identifier without quotes; 2 calls per message; no prompt edits inside the window
arms.qwen1p5b_two_stage_lenient: frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, identical two-stage prompts and budgets; small pretrained LM comparator
arms.qwen7b_full_rebuild: ABLATION, not decisive: one-stage full-ledger rebuild with the ledger v2 prompt
arms.annotated_oracle: annotation reference requests fed directly; extra-information ceiling, never a comparator for the language claim

sample_size.rule: if the freeze receipt has fewer than 30 eligible in_schema items the protocol does not start; no synthetic padding

budgets.unchanged: 850/1000 ms numeric budgets and 6/2/5/2/8 operational limits as in contracts/multiservice_comparison_20260911.json

infrastructure_failure: ns-3 build or IPC handshake error
infrastructure_ledger.handling: log to runs/<group>/infrastructure.jsonl, retry the identical cell up to 2 times, never count as a scientific result
infrastructure_ledger.handling_scientific: count as unmet from the message tick; no retry; no prompt change

analysis.estimator: mean paired difference of administrator_obligation_satisfaction, arm minus rule, over eligible items
analysis.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over items, 10000 resamples, seed 0, 95% interval
analysis.advance: lower bound of qwen7b_two_stage_lenient minus rule > 0 AND no increase in hard-SLA violation intervals AND deadline shortfall not worse AND (amendment D) recovery violation intervals of qwen7b_two_stage_lenient, summed over the paired items, not above the rule arm; the mean satisfaction may not compensate a deadline or recovery regression; report qwen1p5b_two_stage_lenient minus rule and qwen7b_full_rebuild minus rule alongside; parity of 1.5B with 7B is not evidence against language value
analysis.tie: if the interval covers 0 write the tie up as the result and stop; do not pivot, re-prompt or add arms before 2026-10-08
analysis.negative: if rule beats qwen7b_two_stage_lenient with lower bound > 0 the language claim on this task is closed

gates.hard_sla: sum of hard-SLA violation intervals, decisive arm <= rule, over paired items
gates.deadline: deadline misses and summed shortfall bytes, decisive arm <= rule, deadline judged on the observation at state tick D
gates.recovery: amendment D: sum of recovery violation intervals, decisive arm <= rule
gates.failed_gate: decision "blocked"; the mean difference is reported but does not advance
